content: The role of pretended networking Pretended networking is a feature to reduce energy consumption of an ECU by switching the ECU in a mode called Pretended Networking . In this mode the communication on communication networks is reduced and the ECU can go into power saving modes. 59 of 1124  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 62: AUTOSAR_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 When communication via communication networks is required, the mode Pretended Networking shall be left by request of a mode change to Normal Mode .
